brief: User-provided serene, graceful, realistic sacred sculpture prompt; Japanese temple direction selected for existing setting.
geometryChanges: Integrated, softened eyelids and recessed apertures
Refined bridge, alae, columella and closed smile
Sculpted ear concha instead of raised wire outlines
Continuous sloping shoulder and sleeve transitions
Variable asymmetric robe tension folds and covered knees
Finer scalp curls with elevated crown
materials: Original procedural bronze microfinish embedded in GLBs; vertex patina and PBR metals. No reference pixels, commercial assets or scan data included.
preserved: Raised right palm outward, left palm upward
Lazy loading, LOD and quality controls
Rack navigation, interface mapping and network data
